note: Cases numbered as in the legend. The Stats NZ household-size variants converge after about 2041 because their published projections end in 2043 and household size is held flat after that in every variant: an artefact of the projection horizon, not a model result. Population 5th / 95th: Stats NZ published percentiles, every other input at the adopted settings. Population rows: carbon is the floor area of the path times the Reference carbon per m² of each year (an approximation, listed as a known issue in the CHANGELOG); the engine carbon of the population paths, carbon and boundaries together, is in data/aesa/results.json (population_paths) and is the one used in H11.
